relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Lower preoperative PCS (ρ=0.355) and higher preoperative NDI (ρ=0.336) were weakly correlated with elevated HMGB1.

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: The absolute concentrations of IL-6 and tumor necrosis factor-α were found to be weakly correlated with one another (ρ=0.479).

key_findings: Preoperative serum cytokines (IL-6, IL-8, TNF-alpha, HMGB1) showed only weak correlations with symptoms and outcomes after ACDF.
Cytokine profiling has limited utility in predicting ACDF outcomes.
